description: Adaptive Ranks SVD Compressor: dynamic rank selection per layer based on singular value energy spectra.  Dynamic cumulative singular value energy thresholding:     $$\frac{\sum_{i=1}^r \sigma_i^2}{\sum_{j=1}^d \sigma_j^2} \ge \tau \quad (\tau = 0.92)$$ with minimum rank floor:     $$r_{\min} = \max(16, \lfloor 0.15 \cdot \min(d_{in}, d_{out}) \rfloor)$$ activation covariance whitening:     $$M = W

components.math_latex: y_t = z_t (\Sigma_r U_r^\top) + b, \quad U_r \in \mathbb{R}^{d_{out} \times r}
